segments.text: Today, I'll show you how to cut and weld a practical product.
segments.zh: 今天，我来演示如何切割和焊接一件实用的产品。

segments.text: This is a kitchen spice rack.
segments.zh: 这是一个厨房调料架。

segments.text: It can be secured on the wall by tightening screws or nails through the holes.
segments.zh: 可以用螺丝或钉子穿过这些孔，把它固定在墙上。

segments.text: The spice rack is easy to install and remove.
segments.zh: 这个调料架安装和拆卸都很方便。

segments.text: Today, let's see how to make such a spice rack.
segments.zh: 今天，我们来看看怎么做这样一个调料架。

segments.text: Before our creation, let's decide the material type and thickness.
segments.zh: 在动手制作之前，我们先确定材料类型和厚度。

segments.text: As they determine the shielding gas, nozzles, gas pressure, and processing settings we apply.
segments.zh: 因为它们决定了我们要使用的保护气、喷嘴、气压和加工设置。

segments.text: Here we use 2 millimeter stainless steel as an example.
segments.zh: 这里我们以 2 毫米不锈钢为例。

segments.text: Then apply the corresponding nozzle, shielding gas and gas pressure as required.
segments.zh: 然后按要求使用相应的喷嘴、保护气和气压。

segments.text: First, let's prepare the devices.
segments.zh: 首先，我们来准备设备。

segments.text: This is X-Tool air compressor, this is X-Tool air dryer, and this one is X-Tool metal fab
segments.zh: 这是 xTool 空压机，这是 xTool 干燥机，这台是 xTool MetalFab

segments.text: laser welder used tubes to connect these devices.
segments.zh: 激光焊机。用气管把这些设备连接起来。

segments.text: Use a tube to connect the air compressor and the air dryer inlet port.
segments.zh: 用一根气管连接空压机和干燥机的进气口。

segments.text: Look, this is the inlet port, and that is the outlet port.
segments.zh: 看，这是进气口，那是出气口。

segments.text: Use another tube to connect the outlet port and the laser welder.
segments.zh: 再用一根气管连接出气口和激光焊机。

segments.text: Now we've finished the device connection.
segments.zh: 现在设备连接就完成了。

segments.text: Next, power on the air dryer, then power on the air compressor.
segments.zh: 接下来，先打开干燥机电源，再打开空压机电源。

segments.text: Set the gas pressure to 1 megapascal.
segments.zh: 把气压设为 1 兆帕。

segments.text: Wait until the device generates gas.
segments.zh: 等待设备产生气体。

segments.text: During this process, install the welding head to our X-Tool metal fab CNC cutter.
segments.zh: 在这个过程中，把焊接头安装到我们的 xTool MetalFab 数控切割机上。

segments.text: There are 2 grooves on the welding head and 2 pins on the device.
segments.zh: 焊接头上有 2 个凹槽，设备上有 2 个定位销。

segments.text: Align them and install the welding head.
segments.zh: 把它们对齐，装上焊接头。

segments.text: If the welding head is right after processing, wear heat resistant gloves before the installation.
segments.zh: 如果焊接头刚加工完，安装前要戴上耐热手套。

segments.text: Now the welding head is well secured.
segments.zh: 现在焊接头已经固定好了。

segments.text: Next, install the save gas nozzle.
segments.zh: 接下来，安装省气喷嘴。

segments.text: Also, please wear heat resistant gloves if the welding head is right after processing.
segments.zh: 同样，如果焊接头刚加工完，请戴上耐热手套。

segments.text: Rotate to remove the ordinary nozzle.
segments.zh: 旋转取下普通喷嘴。

segments.text: Then rotate to install the save gas nozzle.
segments.zh: 然后旋转装上省气喷嘴。

segments.text: Make sure it is tightened.
segments.zh: 确保它已拧紧。

segments.text: This is 2 millimeter stainless steel.
segments.zh: 这是 2 毫米不锈钢。

segments.text: Remember to remove its protective film on both sides.
segments.zh: 记得撕掉它两面的保护膜。

segments.text: Next, secure the material.
segments.zh: 接下来，固定材料。

segments.text: Rotate to loosen the knob.
segments.zh: 旋转松开旋钮。

segments.text: Then insert the material into the slot and align it properly.
segments.zh: 然后把材料插入槽中，并对齐摆正。

segments.text: Insert the material into the left slot in the same way.
segments.zh: 用同样的方法把材料插入左侧的槽中。

segments.text: Lower the linkage levers and tighten the knobs on both sides.
segments.zh: 放下联动杆，拧紧两侧的旋钮。

segments.text: Insert the USB cable to our CNC cutter and power it on.
segments.zh: 把 USB 线插到我们的数控切割机上，并打开电源。

segments.text: Insert the other end to the computer.
segments.zh: 把另一端插到电脑上。

segments.text: Power on the laser welder.
segments.zh: 打开激光焊机电源。

segments.text: Remove the safety instructions and tap the confirm button.
segments.zh: 移除安全说明，点击“确认”按钮。

segments.text: Wait until the touchscreen indicates that CNC cutter takes control.
segments.zh: 等到触摸屏显示数控切割机已接管控制。

segments.text: Next, let's prepare the software.
segments.zh: 接下来，我们来准备软件。

segments.text: Open X-Tool Studio and click new project.
segments.zh: 打开 xTool Studio，点击“新建项目”。

segments.text: Connect the device.
segments.zh: 连接设备。

segments.text: After connection, we can view the material via camera, which is convenient for pattern
segments.zh: 连接后，我们可以通过摄像头查看材料，方便图案

segments.text: positioning.
segments.zh: 定位。

segments.text: Import a design file for cutting.
segments.zh: 导入一个用于切割的设计文件。

segments.text: Add a lead in if the material thickness is 2 millimeters or more.
segments.zh: 如果材料厚度为 2 毫米或以上，要添加引入线。

segments.text: The lead in ensures smooth and complete cutting of the contour and leaves the cutting defect
segments.zh: 引入线能确保轮廓切割得平滑完整，并把切割缺陷留在

segments.text: outside the contour.
segments.zh: 轮廓之外。

segments.text: The lead in length is usually 1 to 3 times the material thickness, about 3 to 10 millimeters.
segments.zh: 引入线长度通常是材料厚度的 1 到 3 倍，大约 3 到 10 毫米。

segments.text: The material thickness in this video is 2 millimeters and thus requires a lead in.
segments.zh: 本视频中材料厚度为 2 毫米，因此需要引入线。

segments.text: The following shows how to add a 4 millimeter lead in, twice the material thickness.
segments.zh: 下面演示如何添加 4 毫米的引入线，也就是材料厚度的两倍。

segments.text: First, select all the objects and ungroup them.
segments.zh: 首先，选中所有对象，并取消组合。

segments.text: Then, add different colors to contours based on the lead in type they require.
segments.zh: 然后，根据轮廓需要的引入线类型，给它们设置不同的颜色。

segments.text: For contours that require external lead ins, set their colors to black.
segments.zh: 对需要外引入线的轮廓，把它们的颜色设为黑色。

segments.text: To do this, press shift and select all the target contours.
segments.zh: 为此，按住 Shift 键并选中所有目标轮廓。

segments.text: Right click to change their colors to black.
segments.zh: 右键单击，把它们的颜色改为黑色。

segments.text: Next, we are going to add external lead ins to the black contours and inner lead ins
segments.zh: 接下来，我们要给黑色轮廓添加外引入线，并给

segments.text: to the red ones.
segments.zh: 红色轮廓添加内引入线。

segments.text: In general, solid patterns require external lead ins, like the parts in black in this
segments.zh: 一般来说，实心图案需要外引入线，比如本视频中黑色的部分，

segments.text: video, while hollow patterns require inner lead ins, like the parts in red in this video.
segments.zh: 而镂空图案需要内引入线，比如本视频中红色的部分。

segments.text: Select all the black patterns and add external lead ins.
segments.zh: 选中所有黑色图案，添加外引入线。

segments.text: Set the lead in length to 4 millimeters, twice the material thickness, zoom in and you can
segments.zh: 把引入线长度设为 4 毫米，即材料厚度的两倍，放大就能

segments.text: see these lead ins.
segments.zh: 看到这些引入线。

segments.text: Then, select all the red patterns and add inner lead ins.
segments.zh: 然后，选中所有红色图案，添加内引入线。

segments.text: Inner lead ins can be a bit shorter, for example, 3 millimeters.
segments.zh: 内引入线可以短一点，比如 3 毫米。

segments.text: Okay, now the inner lead ins are added.
segments.zh: 好，现在内引入线已经添加好了。

segments.text: For hollow patterns, their inner sections will be cut and discarded, ensure that the
segments.zh: 对于镂空图案，它们内部的部分会被切掉丢弃，所以要确保

segments.text: lead ins are set inside to avoid damaging the desired parts.
segments.zh: 引入线设在内侧，以免损坏需要保留的部分。

segments.text: After adding lead ins, place patterns in proper position.
segments.zh: 添加引入线后，把图案放到合适的位置。

segments.text: Click mode and select cutting with fixture as the processing mode.
segments.zh: 点击“模式”，选择“带夹具切割”作为加工模式。

segments.text: Click material and select the 2 millimeter stainless steel.
segments.zh: 点击“材料”，选择 2 毫米不锈钢。

segments.text: The settings are recommended based on the nozzle and the shielding gas we select.
segments.zh: 这些设置是根据我们选择的喷嘴和保护气推荐的。

segments.text: Click nozzle and select save gas nozzle.
segments.zh: 点击“喷嘴”，选择省气喷嘴。

segments.text: Select gas and select X-Tool air compressor.
segments.zh: 点击“气体”，选择 xTool 空压机。

segments.text: For better cutting results, click cab librate the capacitive sensor.
segments.zh: 为了获得更好的切割效果，点击“校准电容传感器”。

segments.text: Click a solid area on the canvas and wait until the calibration is done.
segments.zh: 点击画布上的一个实心区域，等待校准完成。

segments.text: Then, preview the cutting position.
segments.zh: 然后，预览切割位置。

segments.text: You can click the camera icon to capture a real-time image of the material, or click
segments.zh: 你可以点击摄像头图标拍摄材料的实时图像，或者点击

segments.text: the framing button as shown in the video, which provides a more accurate preview.
segments.zh: 视频中所示的走边框按钮，这样预览更准确。

segments.text: Observe the red spot and note that the cutting position must be at least 1.5 centimeters from
segments.zh: 观察红点，注意切割位置必须留出至少 1.5 厘米，

segments.text: the edge.
segments.zh: 从边缘算起。

segments.text: Confirm the cutting position and click process.
segments.zh: 确认切割位置后，点击“加工”。

segments.text: Follow the instructions to adjust the cutting tip knob value.
segments.zh: 按照说明调整切割头旋钮的数值。

segments.text: Ensure that the knob is turned to the required scale value.
segments.zh: 确保旋钮转到要求的刻度值。

segments.text: If the knob value is wrong, incomplete cutting or dross may occur.
segments.zh: 如果旋钮数值不对，可能会出现切不透或挂渣。

segments.text: Manually move the X-axis guide rail to the front.
segments.zh: 手动把 X 轴导轨移到前面。

segments.text: Open the toggle latch.
segments.zh: 打开搭扣锁。

segments.text: Adjust the knob to the required value minus 4 in this video.
segments.zh: 把旋钮调到要求的数值，本视频中是 -4。

segments.text: Then close the latch.
segments.zh: 然后扣上搭扣。

segments.text: Click start.
segments.zh: 点击“开始”。

segments.text: Close the lid and press the button on the device.
segments.zh: 合上盖子，按下设备上的按钮。

segments.text: Operate with heat-resistant gloves or after the cutting tip cools down, and use a hammer
segments.zh: 戴上耐热手套操作，或者等切割头冷却后再操作，并用锤子

segments.text: to knock off the cut parts, because workpieces in irregular shapes may not fall off due to
segments.zh: 把切好的零件敲下来，因为形状不规则的工件可能会因为

segments.text: friction.
segments.zh: 摩擦而掉不下来。

segments.text: Besides, doing so helps to avoid skin burns.
segments.zh: 另外，这样做也有助于避免皮肤烫伤。

segments.text: Loosen the fixtures to take out parts.
segments.zh: 松开夹具，取出零件。

segments.text: Pull out the base plate and fetch the rest of the parts.
segments.zh: 拉出底盘，取出其余的零件。

segments.text: Remove the cutting tip and replace with a welding tip.
segments.zh: 取下切割头，换上焊接头嘴。

segments.text: Align the protrusion of the welding tip and the groove of the welding head.
segments.zh: 把焊接头嘴的凸起对准焊接头的凹槽。

segments.text: On the touch screen, tap system setting and check the value of focus scale reference.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上点击“系统设置”，查看焦点刻度参考值。

segments.text: Check if the welding nozzle is of the same value.
segments.zh: 检查焊接喷嘴是否为相同的数值。

segments.text: If yes, no calibration is needed.
segments.zh: 如果是，就不需要校准。

segments.text: If not, adjust the graduated tube.
segments.zh: 如果不是，就调整刻度管。

segments.text: Open the fastener.
segments.zh: 打开卡扣。

segments.text: Push or pull the welding nozzle to adjust it to the reference value.
segments.zh: 推动或拉动焊接喷嘴，把它调到参考值。

segments.text: Pull the welding wire.
segments.zh: 拉出焊丝。

segments.text: The welding wire should comes out from the groove of the welding nozzle.
segments.zh: 焊丝应该从焊接喷嘴的槽中出来。

segments.text: The welding head is ready now.
segments.zh: 现在焊接头已经准备好了。

segments.text: Tap machine status on the touch screen to view the gas state.
segments.zh: 在触摸屏上点击“机器状态”，查看气体状态。

segments.text: To weld materials, use nitrogen or argon as the shielding gas.
segments.zh: 焊接材料时，使用氮气或氩气作为保护气。

segments.text: Before replacing the gas, press the grip sensing button and trigger on the welding head for
segments.zh: 更换气体之前，按下焊接头上的握持感应按钮和扳机，

segments.text: gas depressurizing.
segments.zh: 给气体泄压。

segments.text: Keep depressurizing until gas pressure turns to zero kilopascals on the touch screen.
segments.zh: 持续泄压，直到触摸屏上的气压变为 0 千帕。

segments.text: When replace the tube, push and hold the inlet collet and pull out the original tube.
segments.zh: 更换气管时，按住进气口的卡套，把原来的气管拔出来。

segments.text: Insert the nitrogen tube into the inlet.
segments.zh: 把氮气管插入进气口。

segments.text: A flow valve of 15 to 30 liters per minute is preferred for welding.
segments.zh: 焊接时最好使用每分钟 15 到 30 升的流量阀。

segments.text: If not available, a pressure reducing valve with 0.1 to 0.2 megapascals works as an
segments.zh: 如果没有，也可以用 0.1 到 0.2 兆帕的减压阀作为

segments.text: alternative.
segments.zh: 替代。

segments.text: In this video, a pressure reducing valve is used.
segments.zh: 本视频中使用的是减压阀。

segments.text: This gauge displays the pressure inside the gas cylinder, while this one displays the
segments.zh: 这个表显示的是气瓶内的压力，而这个表显示的是

segments.text: output gas pressure.
segments.zh: 输出气压。

segments.text: Next, adjust the output gas pressure of nitrogen.
segments.zh: 接下来，调节氮气的输出气压。

segments.text: Press the grip sensing button and trigger on the welding head while adjusting the valve
segments.zh: 按住焊接头上的握持感应按钮和扳机，同时调节阀门

segments.text: knob until gas pressure turns to 200 kilopascals or so on the touch screen.
segments.zh: 旋钮，直到触摸屏上的气压变为 200 千帕左右。

segments.text: Tap standard mode.
segments.zh: 点击“标准模式”。

segments.text: Then weld, select stainless steel for the material type.
segments.zh: 然后选择“焊接”，材料类型选择不锈钢。

segments.text: Select two millimeters for the material thickness.
segments.zh: 材料厚度选择 2 毫米。

segments.text: Select one millimeter for the wire diameter.
segments.zh: 焊丝直径选择 1 毫米。

segments.text: Tap enable wire feeding and enable lasering.
segments.zh: 点击“启用送丝”和“启用激光”。

segments.text: Confirm.
segments.zh: 确认。

segments.text: Remember to attach the workpiece sensing cable clamp to the conductive work table where you
segments.zh: 记得把工件感应线夹夹在放置工件的导电工作台上，

segments.text: place the workpieces.
segments.zh: 也就是你放工件的地方。

segments.text: By doing so, the current flows from the wire to the workpiece through the work table and
segments.zh: 这样，电流从焊丝流向工件，经过工作台，再

segments.text: returns to the laser welder via the workpiece sensing cable.
segments.zh: 通过工件感应线回到激光焊机。

segments.text: No laser will be emitted if the closed loop breaks.
segments.zh: 如果闭合回路断开，就不会出激光。

segments.text: Before welding, turn on the wire feed, enable switch.
segments.zh: 焊接前，打开送丝使能开关。

segments.text: This is the feed button.
segments.zh: 这是送丝按钮。

segments.text: This one is the retract button.
segments.zh: 这个是回抽按钮。

segments.text: Press the buttons to adjust the wire until its tip coincides with the red spot.
segments.zh: 按这些按钮调整焊丝，直到它的末端与红点重合。

segments.text: Now let's weld the materials.
segments.zh: 现在我们来焊接材料。

segments.text: Weld both ends of the materials.
segments.zh: 先焊接材料的两端。

segments.text: Then weld along the welding seam.
segments.zh: 然后沿着焊缝焊接。

segments.text: Doing so ensures a straight welding line.
segments.zh: 这样可以确保焊缝是直的。

segments.text: Position the welding head at a 45 degree angle towards the welding seam.
segments.zh: 让焊接头朝焊缝成 45 度角。

segments.text: Press and hold the grip sensing button and trigger.
segments.zh: 按住握持感应按钮和扳机。

segments.text: The emitted laser fixes the materials with the wire.
segments.zh: 发出的激光用焊丝把材料固定在一起。

segments.text: Keep welding non-stop from the beginning to the end.
segments.zh: 从头到尾不停顿地连续焊接。

segments.text: A force will push you forward, just follow that force and pull steadily backward.
segments.zh: 会有一股力把你往前推，只要顺着这股力，稳稳地往后拉就行。

segments.text: Since other parts are under less stress, connecting them only by welding the corners also works.
segments.zh: 由于其他部位受力较小，只焊接拐角把它们连接起来也是可以的。

segments.text: If the welding seam is blackened after welding, replace with the cleaning nozzle to clean
segments.zh: 如果焊接后焊缝发黑，就换上清洗喷嘴来清洁

segments.text: the seam.
segments.zh: 焊缝。

segments.text: Remove the welding nozzle and the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 取下焊接喷嘴和送丝管。

segments.text: Align and install the cleaning nozzle.
segments.zh: 对准并装上清洗喷嘴。

segments.text: Select the standard mode, choose clean, select the corresponding material, choose the
segments.zh: 选择标准模式，选择“清洗”，选择对应的材料，选择

segments.text: appropriate width, enable lasering and tap confirm.
segments.zh: 合适的宽度，启用激光，然后点击“确认”。

segments.text: Now let's clean the welding seam.
segments.zh: 现在我们来清洁焊缝。

segments.text: Easy peasy, right?
segments.zh: 很简单，对吧？

segments.text: In general, the welding effect is very nice.
segments.zh: 总的来说，焊接效果非常好。

segments.text: Compared with traditional welding, the laser welder works faster and produces a better appearance.
segments.zh: 与传统焊接相比，激光焊机速度更快，外观效果也更好。

segments.text: The following concludes today's processing steps.
segments.zh: 今天的加工步骤就到这里。

segments.text: Here are some tips for smooth cutting and welding.
segments.zh: 下面是一些让切割和焊接更顺利的小技巧。
